perRequirement.imageRegion: All three seed rows; central flame and residual-fragment region.
perRequirement.observation: Reviewed all 24 Beauty images (3 seed rows x 8 frames). Frames 1, 21, 60, 120, and 180 show an active flame and frame 240 shows stopping, but colored flame-like fragments remain visibly present at frame 300 even though that slot is labeled idle; frame 360 is clean. The fixed set therefore does not show a coherent cleanup transition into the first idle state.
